rows.my_view: Skeptical from the start, asking what would have to happen for a $17B valuation to make sense rather than assuming it does.
rows.committee: The committee agrees fully: at 92x sales the price already assumes IonQ wins a binary science race and 10x's revenue, leaving no margin of safety.

rows.my_view: Questioned whether the +755% Q1 jump reflects real adoption or just pilots, grants, and lumpy contracts.
rows.committee: The committee shares the doubt: the growth is dazzling but its organic-vs-acquired composition is a black box until the 2026-08-04 print.

rows.my_view: Wanted commercialization realism probed rather than assumed.
rows.committee: The committee agrees the 63% to 40% to 24% gross-margin slide is the single most damning number, likely mix-driven but unproven until disclosure.

rows.my_view: Insisted durability be tested against big-tech and pure-play rivals, not assumed.
rows.committee: The committee agrees the moat is unproven: distribution is rented from cloud rivals, switching costs are near-zero, and everything hinges on trapped-ion winning an unresolved architecture race.

rows.my_view: Flagged dilution and capital requirements as a risk to scrutinize, implicitly a survival bleed.
rows.committee: The committee agrees dilution is heavy but reframes it as opportunistic M&A currency — ~$4B of stock issued against ~$300M burn — that only works while the multiple stays inflated.

rows.my_view: Named timeline and hype without adoption as the core danger.
rows.committee: The committee agrees timing is the killer: ~$425M annual burn happens now while the payoff is a distant, unforecastable science bet with no margin of safety.

rows.my_view: Not specified; the brief did not anticipate the warrant-accounting reflexivity trap.
rows.committee: The owner underweighted that the +$805M GAAP 'profit' reverses into an ugly loss on any stock decline, creating a self-reinforcing down-quarter trap for anyone screening on reported EPS.

rows.my_view: Not specified as a single item.
rows.committee: The 2026-08-04 Q2 print is the one event that resolves everything — gross-margin direction, organic revenue mix, share count, and cash — and settles whether this is a platform or a narrative.

confidence.label: High
confidence.why: The skeptical brief and the evidence converge on nearly every weighted dimension, and the decisive data is one known disclosure date away.

final_verdict: Correctly a pass for now — the skeptical instinct held, this is narrative-priced speculation at 92x sales, and the one disclosure that could change the picture prints on 2026-08-04.
